name: @epicai/chariot
description: Epic AI® Chariot — Intelligent Virtual Assistant (IVA) MCP Gateway with enterprise IAM, RBAC, credential vault, and Internal API Discovery. Deploy air-gapped, standalone SaaS, or via hyperscaler PaaS.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:native && npm run build
scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path'),d='./dist/bin';if(!fs.existsSync(d)){console.error('prepack: dist/bin missing — run npm-run-build before npm-pack');process.exit(1);}for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d))if(f.endsWith('.js'))fs.chmodSync(p.join(d,f),0o755);"
scripts.prepublishOnly:
node -e "const s=require('node:child_process').execSync('git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal',{encoding:'utf-8'}); if(s.trim().length){console.error('refusing to publish: dirty working tree
'+s); process.exit(1)}" && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm run build && npm run typecheck && node -e "import('./scripts/release.mjs').then(m=>m.stripInternalTelemetry('./dist')).catch(e=>{console.error('internal-telemetry strip failed:',e.message);process.exit(1)})" && npm run leak:scan -- src dist chariot-adapter-bundle.json chariot-adapter-catalog.json chariot-current.json README.md docs/product docs/product/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md docs/product/SECURITY.md package.json native/integrity.json LICENSE-ELASTIC && node scripts/tarball-leak-scan.mjs && node scripts/verify-manifest-version.mjs && node scripts/verify-manifest-coverage.mjs && node scripts/verify-catalog-signature-prepublish.mjs && node scripts/verify-dependency-provenance.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const cp=require('node:child_process');const crypto=require('node:crypto');const attPath=process.env.CHARIOT_EVAL_GATE_ATTESTATION;const attSha=process.env.CHARIOT_EVAL_GATE_ATTESTATION_SHA256;const attSig=process.env.CHARIOT_EVAL_GATE_ATTESTATION_SIG;if(!attPath||!attSha||!attSig){console.error('refusing to publish: missing deterministic eval attestation');process.exit(1)}if(!fs.existsSync(attPath)){console.error('refusing to publish: deterministic eval attestation file missing');process.exit(1)}const body=fs.readFileSync(attPath,'utf8');const actual=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(body,'utf8').digest('hex');if(actual!==attSha){console.error('refusing to publish: deterministic eval attestation hash mismatch');process.exit(1)}let att;try{att=JSON.parse(body)}catch(e){console.error('refusing to publish: deterministic eval attestation is not valid JSON');process.exit(1)}const publicKeyPem='-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
MCowBQYDK2VwAyEAaAjNCRAxZlceSqsD3HXRK5HaxYlAtDEIyhebMycQUa8=
-----END PUBLIC KEY-----
';const publicKey=crypto.createPublicKey(publicKeyPem);if(!crypto.verify(null,Buffer.from(body,'utf8'),publicKey,Buffer.from(attSig,'base64'))){console.error('refusing to publish: deterministic eval attestation signature mismatch');process.exit(1)}const head=cp.execSync('git rev-parse HEAD',{encoding:'utf-8'}).trim();const version=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./package.json','utf8')).version;const runId=process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID;const runAttempt=process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT;if(!runId||!runAttempt){console.error('refusing to publish: missing GitHub run identity');process.exit(1)}if(att.gate!=='deterministic-ai-evals'||att.status!=='passed'||att.commit!==head||att.version!==version||att.run_id!==runId||att.run_attempt!==runAttempt){console.error('refusing to publish: invalid deterministic eval attestation');process.exit(1)}" && (if [ -n "$(find test -maxdepth 1 -name '*.mjs' -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then npm test; fi) && node -e "const s=require('node:child_process').execSync('git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal',{encoding:'utf-8'}); if(s.trim().length){console.error('refusing to publish: working tree became dirty after tests
'+s); process.exit(1)}"
